comment: DVB-S2 PLHEADER: 26 SOF symbols then the PLS code, 64 symbols, all pi/2-BPSK. The PLS carries s2x (b0: 1 for a DVB-S2X MODCOD), the MODCOD (5 bits), the frame size (1: short) and pilots (1: on): a (32,7) code (the (32,6) first-order Reed-Muller code of DVB-S2 and one more row for s2x), each bit sent twice, the second copy XOR the pilots bit, then XOR a fixed scrambling word. With s2x 0 it is DVB-S2's header exactly; with s2x 1 the PLS is sent a quarter turn on from the SOF, and (modcod, short) read together as DVB-S2X's MODCOD and frame length (EN 302 307-2 table 17a: PLS value 128 + 4 modcod + 2 short + pilots)
